tickets.title: Fix look-ahead bias in compute_probability_matrix
tickets.defect: Look-ahead bias in compute_probability_matrix: the 'prob_all' field (set from train_p on line 273) is actually the FULL-SAMPLE conditional probability computed from n_up/n_resolved over ALL data (lines 225-236), not the train-only probability. The backtester filters trades on this value (backtest_adapter.py:58), so every trade is evaluated against a probability computed using data that includes that trade's own period. Additionally, direction is chosen using full-sample data (line 231, p_up_cond from all data), peeking at the test set. Finally, tr_prob falls back to train_p (the full-sample value) when train data is empty (line 248), another look-ahead. Fix: (1) Rename 'prob_all' to 'prob_full' throughout for clarity. (2) Compute direction from TRAIN data only (train_df), not full sample. (3) When train data is empty for a cell, tr_prob should be NaN, not the full-sample value. (4) Add a new function compute_expanding_probabilities that, for each range row, computes the (slot,bucket) probability using ONLY data from ranges that came BEFORE it (strict temporal cutoff). This produces a walk-forward probability per row with zero look-ahead. (5) Update the returned dict to include 'prob_full' (renamed from 'prob_all') and keep prob_train/prob_test as-is but now direction is from train data. (6) Update the Z-score to use prob_train not prob_full.
tickets.spec: Rename prob_all to prob_full in the record dict. Compute direction from train_df only. When train data is empty for a cell, set tr_prob to NaN. Add compute_expanding_probabilities(ranges_df) function that returns a DataFrame with exp_prob, exp_dir, exp_n, exp_res_rate columns computed using only prior rows (strict temporal cutoff). Update Z-score to use prob_train.

regions.note: The entire compute_probability_matrix function. Rename prob_all->prob_full, compute direction from train_df only, fix tr_prob fallback to NaN, add compute_expanding_probabilities function after this function.
Add compute_expanding_probabilities to the __all__ list after compute_probability_matrix

tickets.title: Fix extractor to use expanding window probabilities
tickets.defect: extractor.py uses rec['prob_all'] (line 86) for the backtest signal probability field s_prob. Since prob_all is the full-sample probability (look-ahead bias), the backtest is in-sample. Fix: replace the static lookup with a call to compute_expanding_probabilities. The extractor should call compute_expanding_probabilities(ranges_df) to get a per-row walk-forward probability, then use those per-row values to populate s_dir, s_prob, s_res_rate, s_n, and is_qualified for each row. The s_train and s_test fields can be removed or kept as the full-sample values for reference, but s_prob MUST be the expanding-window value (zero look-ahead). Also fix: the trade_win computation (line 113) should use the expanding signal, not the static lookup.
tickets.spec: Replace the static LUT lookup loop with compute_expanding_probabilities(ranges_df). Use the per-row expanding values for s_dir, s_prob, s_res_rate, s_n, is_qualified. Keep s_train and s_test from the full matrix for reference. Update trade_win to use the expanding signal.

tickets.title: Fix backtest_adapter slippage, Sharpe, collision mode
tickets.defect: backtest_adapter.py has three issues: (1) Slippage is one-sided (line 109): 'points = exit_price - entry_price - self.slippage_pts' subtracts slippage once, but both entry and exit have slippage. Fix: multiply slippage by 2 (entry + exit). Same for short trades (line 141). (2) Sharpe ratio annualization is arbitrary (line 198): uses np.sqrt(252 * 4) assuming exactly 4 trades/day. Fix: annualize based on actual trade frequency. If trades span N_days calendar days with T trades, annualization factor = sqrt(252 * T / N_days). If all trades are on the same day or N_days==0, return per-trade Sharpe (mean/std, no annualization). (3) Intrabar collision always pessimistic (lines 100-103): when both target and stop are hit, always assumes stop-first. Add a 'collision_mode' parameter with values 'pessimistic' (stop-first), 'optimistic' (target-first), and 'conservative' (assume worst of the two: if stop loss > target gain, assume stop; else assume target). The conservative mode is the new default since it's more realistic than always-stop.
tickets.spec: Add collision_mode parameter (default 'conservative') to __init__. Fix slippage to 2x (entry+exit) in both long and short paths. Add collision_mode logic for target+stop hit. Replace fixed Sharpe annualization with actual trade frequency: sqrt(252 * T / N_days) where N_days is calendar days spanned. If N_days==0, return per-trade Sharpe.

regions.note: Constructor __init__ and the full class. Add collision_mode parameter with default 'conservative'. Fix slippage to 2x, add collision_mode logic, fix Sharpe ratio annualization.

(2) The new test 'test_lookahead_bias' was already added to the test file (it is the failing acceptance test for T1). Update it if needed to match the actual compute_expanding_probabilities API.
